notes:
=== CONCEPT ===
--min-rate N sets a floor on packets per second. When network bandwidth and detection threshold are known (white-box test with whitelisted scanning), this can cut scan time to ~1/3 without missing results. In example: 29s → 8s, same port count.

=== RISK ===
On unknown/monitored networks, high rates trigger IDS/IPS blocks. --min-rate is most appropriate when scanner is whitelisted in IPS rules, or in internal trusted environments. High rates generate traffic anomalies visible to NOC/SOC.

=== vs TIMING TEMPLATES ===
--min-rate overrides the per-packet rate floor regardless of -T setting. More granular than -T templates but requires knowledge of the network capacity.
